commands: set -euo pipefail; DIR="$HOME/.local/share/blueeye-tracker/signing"; KS="$DIR/tester.p12"; PW="$DIR/tester.password"; ALIAS=blueeye-tester; mkdir -p "$DIR"; chmod 700 "$DIR"; if [ ! -s "$KS" ] || [ ! -s "$PW" ]; then PASS=$(openssl rand -hex 24); printf '%s' "$PASS" > "$PW"; chmod 600 "$PW"; keytool -genkeypair -keystore "$KS" -storetype PKCS12 -storepass "$PASS" -keypass "$PASS" -alias "$ALIAS" -keyalg RSA -keysize 4096 -validity 36500 -dname 'CN=BlueEye Tracker Tester, OU=Stabilization, O=BlueEye, C=PL' >/dev/null 2>&1; chmod 600 "$KS"; echo created=1; else PASS=$(cat "$PW"); echo created=0; fi; CERT_SHA=$(keytool -list -v -keystore "$KS" -storepass "$PASS" -alias "$ALIAS" | awk -F': ' '/SHA256:/{print $2; exit}' | tr -d ':' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f'); echo tester_cert_sha256=$CERT_SHA; stat -f 'keystore_mode=%Sp keystore_size=%z' "$KS"; stat -f 'password_mode=%Sp password_size=%z' "$PW"
